title: An Experimental Test of Fundraising Appeals Targeting Donor and Recipient Benefits
Testing for Crowd Out in Social Nudges: Evidence from a Natural Field Experiment in the Market for Electricity
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: This study considers the response of household electricity consumption to social nudges during peak load events. Our investigation considers two social nudges. The first targets conservation during peak load events, while the second promotes aggregate conservation. Using data from a natural field experiment with 42,100 households, we find that both social nudges reduce peak load electricity consumption by 2 to 4% when implemented in isolation and by nearly 7% when implemented in combination. These findings suggest an important role for social nudges in the regulation of electricity markets and a limited role for crowd out effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了在用电负荷高峰事件期间，家庭用电量对社会助推（social nudges）的反应。我们考察了两种社会助推：第一种针对高峰负荷事件期间的节约用电，第二种则促进总体节约。利用一项涉及42,100户家庭的自然现场实验数据，我们发现，两种社会助推单独实施时，均可将高峰用电量降低2%至4%；二者结合实施时，则可降低近7%。这些发现表明，社会助推在电力市场监管中可发挥重要作用，而挤出效应的作用则有限。

title: Using Field Experiments in Environmental and Resource Economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This study showcases the usefulness of field experiments to the study of environmental and resource economics. Our focus pertains to work related to field experiments in the area of 'behavioral' environmental and resource economics. Within this rubric, we discuss research in two areas: those that inform i) benefit cost analysis and ii) conservation of resources. Within each realm, we show how field experiments have been able to test the relevant theories, provide important parameters to construct new theories, and guide policymakers. We conclude with thoughts on how field experiments can be used to deepen our understanding of important areas within environmental and resource economics.
abstract_zh: 本研究展示了田野实验对环境与资源经济学研究的实用价值。我们的关注点在于与“行为”环境与资源经济学领域中田野实验相关的工作。在这一范畴内，我们讨论两方面的研究：一是服务于i）成本效益分析的研究，二是服务于ii）资源保护的研究。在每一领域内，我们展示了田野实验如何检验相关理论、为构建新理论提供重要参数，并指导政策制定者。最后，我们就田野实验如何深化我们对环境与资源经济学重要领域的理解，提出了一些看法。

title: Using Field Experiments to Address Environmental Externalities and Resource Scarcity: Major Lessons Learned and New Directions for Future Research
abstract: This article provides an overview of the use of field experiments in energy and resource economics.I concentrate on two areas of study; field experiments that (i) speak to the use of dynamic pricing plans to manage the use of electricity and water and (ii) explore the adoption of energy saving technologies. Viewed in its totality, this work suggests that both neo-classical factors such as prices or search costs and behavioral constructs such as salience or social norms influence the use of energy and water. For academics, the studies reviewed provide a deeper understanding of individual behavior and the factors that drive the private provision of public goods. For policy makers, the studies reviewed provide a blueprint outlining ways to combine insights from neo-classical and behavioral economics to manage energy/water demand and mitigate externalities generated through their use.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了田野实验在能源与资源经济学中的应用。我集中讨论两个研究领域：（i）关于动态定价计划以管理电力和水资源使用的田野实验；（ii）探讨节能技术采用的田野实验。综合来看，这些研究表明，价格或搜寻成本等新古典因素，以及显著性或社会规范等行为构念，都会影响能源和水资源的使用。对学者而言，所综述的研究有助于更深入地理解个体行为，以及驱动公共物品私人供给的因素。对政策制定者而言，所综述的研究提供了一份蓝图，概述了如何结合新古典经济学与行为经济学的洞见，来管理能源/水需求，并减轻其使用所产生的外部性。
